title: PG Certificate Program in Chief Financial Officer (The CFO Program)
description: Embark on a 12 month learning journey in Financial Leadership, Corporate Governance, and Digital Leadership.

content.title: who should join
points: Current CFOs: Refine financial leadership and stay ahead of trends
Senior Finance Leaders (SVP Directors Controllers): Scale influence and prepare for the CFO seat
High-Potential Finance Managers: Gain comprehensive insights into financial leadership
Strategic Executives: Deepen understanding of CFO responsibilities
Financial Consultants: Understand CFO challenges to better serve clients
Industry Experts: Shift from technical finance to executive leadership

curriculum.title: The Modern CFO
points: Evolving role and mandate of the CFO
CFO as strategic business partner and enterprise leader
CEO–CFO dynamics and cross-functional leadership
Balancing growth, profitability, liquidity, risk, and integrity

curriculum.title: Strategic Financial Leadership
points: Aligning financial strategy with business strategy
Business models and enterprise value drivers
Unit economics and drivers of profitable growth
Strategic decision-making under uncertainty

curriculum.title: Boardroom Leadership & Executive Communication for CFOs
points: Boardroom presence and executive influence
Financial storytelling and strategic narratives
Board and audit committee engagement
Investor relations and earnings communication

curriculum.title: Financial Planning & Analysis
points: Strategic and long-range financial planning
Budgeting, forecasting,  and variance analysis
Financial modelling and driver-based planning
Scenario planning, profitability analysis, and performance insights

curriculum.title: Strategic Finance & Capital Allocation
points: Capital structure and cost of capital
Capital markets and debt, equity, and hybrid financing
Capital allocation and investment prioritization
Fundraising, restructuring, and turnaround finance

curriculum.title: Treasury & Working Capital Management
points: Cash flow forecasting and liquidity management
Working capital and cash conversion optimization
Treasury strategy, banking relationships,  and funding
FX and interest-rate risk, hedging, and funding resilience

curriculum.title: Financial Reporting & Controllership
points: Financial reporting, accounting judgment, and regulatory standards
Financial close, consolidation, and management reporting
Earnings quality, financial red flags, and internal controls
Audit assurance and sustainability reporting

curriculum.title: M&A & Strategic Investments
points: M&A strategy, target screening, and strategic fit
Business valuation and transaction modelling
Due diligence, deal structuring, and transaction economics
Post-merger integration, divestitures, and synergy realization

curriculum.title: Financial Governance & Risk Management
points: Financial governance and CFO accountability
Enterprise risk management and internal control frameworks
Financial, operational, cyber,  and emerging risks
Fraud risk, crisis management, and business resilience

curriculum.title: Tax Strategy & International Finance
points: Corporate tax strategy and tax governance
International taxation and cross-border structuring
Transfer pricing and global tax developments
Foreign operations, transaction tax, and regulatory compliance

curriculum.title: Finance Transformation & FinTech
points: Finance operating model transformation
ERP, cloud, and connected finance architecture
Intelligent automation and touchless finance
FinTech, digital payments, and embedded finance

curriculum.title: Financial Analytics & Decision Support
points: Financial dashboards and performance analytics
Predictive analytics for forecasting and planning
Scenario modelling and advanced financial analytics
Machine learning for financial decision-making

curriculum.title: AI & GenAI for CFOs
points: AI applications across the finance function
GenAI for financial analysis and decision support
AI copilots and AI driven automation
Responsible AI, governance, and controls

curriculum.title: Capstone Project
points: Participants will address a complex CFO-level business challenge by developing an integrated financial strategy for a real or simulated organization. The project may cover financial planning, capital allocation, profitability, risk, M&A, digital finance or AI-led transformation. Participants will apply program frameworks, analyze financial and business data evaluate strategic trade-offs and present actionable recommendations to drive sustainable enterprise value.
144+ Hours of Live Classes
6 Career Sessions by Accredian
Quick Query Resolution
